about: Bot scorecard limits (docs/BOTS.md, Scorecard). `pnpm bot-report --check` plays `check` and holds it to `checkLimits`; the nightly full suite (`pnpm bot-report --suite=all`, then `--judge`) is held to `limits`. Keys: all, a mode (core.ctf), or a mode and a map (core.ctf/diamond_park). Each measure is the most it may be (failed searches, idle, frozen, stuck, spawn deaths, think ms) or the least (captures, takes, hill time, coverage, kills); bot-report.ts METRICS says which. Set 2026-11-06 (wip/bots-a) from the check (failed searches 0.04 %, no-route idle 0, idle out of a fight 3.8 %, stuck 1.07 a bot-minute; flag takes 1.5 a match, hill held 60 %) and the CTF suite, with room for changes that only shuffle a seeded match. A worse number fails: raise a limit only with the reason in the commit.
